title: Sign in and sign up page
when: The user wants the front end of a login or registration page.
prompt:
Goal: An accessible, password manager friendly sign in and sign up screen.
Steps:
1. One form per task with a clear h1; a link switches between sign in and sign up.
2. Fields with labels and autocomplete: email (username), current-password or new-password.
3. A show password toggle as a button with aria-pressed, not a checkbox hack.
4. Errors in text next to the field and a summary at the top, announced in an aria-live region.
5. Post to the real endpoint the user gave; never store passwords in localStorage.
Quality bar:
- Works with password managers.
- Error messages do not reveal whether an email exists.
- Large touch targets.
Pitfalls:
- Disabling paste in password fields.
- Placeholder as label.
- Saving credentials on the client.
Verify:
- [ ] autocomplete attributes set.
- [ ] Labels on every input.
- [ ] Toggle is a button with type.
- [ ] No localStorage for passwords.
Output: login.html, style.css and auth.js for the UI behavior.

examples.output: sign in form with email and password, autocomplete set, show password button, link to sign up
